tacticalIdentity: Mind control and morale disruption specialist. Wins by turning enemy units against their own team or driving them into panic. CHARM is the strongest single-target control spell in the game. Cannot affect Iron Discipline units (Gilded Throne faction). Countered by Gilded Throne's faction trait.
designNotes: Hard counter to undead armies. Soft counter to Verdant Pact. Iron Discipline provides complete immunity to PANIC and CHARM but not to Mind Spike damage.

baseSpells.description: A mental assault dealing 14 Psychic damage. Does not require line of sight — the attack is mental, not physical. Can target through walls.
baseSpells.designNotes: No-cooldown no-LoS damage. Bypasses terrain obstacles. Punishes units hiding behind cover.

baseSpells.description: Scrambles a target's perception for 2 turns. CONFUSED units move in random directions when attempting to move and have a 50% chance to target allies with attacks.
baseSpells.designNotes: Control debuff. CONFUSED units may walk into hazards or attack their own team.

baseSpells.description: Projects terrifying mental images in a 2-tile radius. Deals 6 Psychic damage and applies PANICKED to enemy units. PANICKED units must move away from the Psychomancer on their next activation.
baseSpells.designNotes: Mass PANIC AoE. Forces enemy repositioning. Iron Discipline immune to PANICKED.

baseSpells.description: Seizes complete mental control of an enemy unit for 1 turn. The CHARMED unit acts under the Psychomancer's player's control for their entire next activation.
baseSpells.designNotes: Strongest control spell in the game. Iron Discipline completely immune. Charmed enemy Mancer casting on their own team is a game-turning play.

baseSpells.description: Floods an allied unit's psyche with weaponized aggression, driving them into a controlled frenzy. Ally enters BERSERK for 2 turns: +2 damage, immune to PANIC and CHARM. Cannot voluntarily disengage from melee while BERSERK. Gilded Throne units retain free movement (Iron Discipline controls the surge).
baseSpells.designNotes: Augmentation spell. Power with behavioral cost. +2 damage and PANIC/CHARM immunity vs. engagement lock constraint.
